sections.h2: Awarded blocks far outnumber reported discoveries; one field is in production

chart.title: 172 blocks awarded against 14 to 21 discoveries reported
chart.sub: Count of OALP blocks and discoveries, as stated in the article.
chart.source: Whalesbook; Lok Sabha answer, 27 March 2025; ministry, March 2026.

sections.means: Only 14 discoveries had been reported against roughly 172 awarded blocks, and the ministry's March 2026 count was 21.
sections.todo: Report discoveries and production alongside block counts when judging the licensing system.

sections.h2: Round IX drew four bidders in total; Round X's bid deadline has been extended repeatedly

chart.title: Each round since IX has offered fewer blocks than the one before
chart.source: PIB; trade coverage cited in the article.

sections.means: Round IX's 28 blocks drew only four bidders in total, and most individual blocks received two bids.
sections.todo: Read Round X and XI as offers until the deadline closes and an award is announced.

sections.h2: Royalty rates were cut on 8 May 2026 for onshore, offshore, gas and nominated blocks

chart.title: Onshore crude royalty fell from 16.66% to 10% on 8 May 2026
chart.sub: Royalty rate by area category, before and after the May 2026 reform, %.
chart.source: psuwatch coverage of the 8 May 2026 reform.

sections.means: The cut covers onshore, offshore and gas royalties, and ICRA says it should improve upstream project returns.
